nina.s: Quick heads-up Customer wants a compact evidence bundle for tenant-77 before their SOC review tomorrow. Need RBAC export, 90d audit slice, KMS envelope proof, rotation log, and a short note on the recent audit-agent patch.
omar.r: I can take RBAC. Should I include infra/service accounts with cross-tenant capability?
lia.ops: yes include them but mark as infra and provide last-used timestamps. Also capture policy_version when available.
sec-bot: [auto] KMS envelope template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/kms-evidence-template Includes key alias, wrap alg, rotation summary.
omar.r: RBAC command: `redwoodctl iam export --scope tenant:77 --format json > rbac_t77.json` then `jq` to split user vs svc.
lia.ops: Audit plan: pull from /audit stream, limit tenant_id=77, timeframe=now-90d. Then `redact-tool --rules security/redact.yml`. Redaction: remove full usernames and file paths; keep action, actor_type, resource_id (tenant-scoped), and timestamp.
nina.s: Add SIEM delivery receipts and a signed ops note confirming no plaintext tenant keys in S3. Also note the agent fix: CVE-2025-3211 patched 2025-11-03, re-ingest done 2025-11-04. Ticket SEC-4622.
omar.r: Filenames: `rbac_t77.json`, `audit_t77_redacted.ndjson`, `kms_envelope_t77.pdf`, `kms_rotation_t77.csv`, `siem_receipts_t77.json`, `incident_SEC-4622.pdf`.
lia.ops: I'll upload redacted exports to `/secure-share/customer/tenant77/` and generate a 7-day presigned link. Originals go to `s3://redwood-evidence/SEC-4622/tenant77/` restricted ACL.
sec-bot: [auto] Evidence checklist validated: RBAC, Audit, KMS proof, Rotation, SIEM receipts, Incident note.
nina.s: Thanks team. I'll assemble the bundle and follow up with legal-friendly wording before sending to the customer. If anything slips, tag @oncall for triage.
